title: A Weakly Group Strategy-Proof and Pareto-Stable Matching Mechanism with Two-Sided Indifferences under Gross Substitutes
abstract: arXiv:2610.30807v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study finite many-to-one matching markets with indifferences on both sides and publicly known firm preferences over sets of workers. A standard approach breaks ties uniformly at random and runs deferred acceptance, which is strategy-proof for workers but may select a weakly stable matching that is Pareto dominated under the agents' original preferences. For the broad class of markets in which each firm's preferences admit a gross substitutes (GS) representation, we construct a deterministic generalized deferred acceptance mechanism that is weakly stable, Pareto efficient with respect to both sides, worker weakly group strategy-proof, and implementable in strongly polynomial time given value oracles for the GS representations. This domain includes nonresponsive firm preferences, such as additive scores under matroid constraints and assignment values. Our analysis bridges ordinal matching with indifferences and competitive equilibria

translated_title: 在总替代性质下具有双边无差异的弱群体策略防操纵与帕累托稳定匹配机制
translated_abstract: 我们研究双方均存在无差异偏好、且企业对工人集合的偏好为公开信息的有限多对一匹配市场。标准做法是通过均匀随机方式打破平局并运行延迟接受算法，该做法对工人是策略防操纵的，但所选出的弱稳定匹配可能在参与者的原始偏好下被帕累托支配。对于每家企业的偏好均可用总替代性质表示的这一广泛市场类别，我们构建了一个确定性的广义延迟接受机制，该机制是弱稳定的、对双方均帕累托有效、对工人是弱群体策略防操纵的，并且在给定GS表示的价值预言机时可在强多项式时间内实现。该领域涵盖非响应型企业偏好，例如拟阵约束下的可加评分以及分配价值。我们的分析架起了含无差异的序数匹配与竞争均衡之间的桥梁。
tldr: 该论文针对企业偏好满足总替代性质的双边无差异多对一匹配市场，提出一个确定性的广义延迟接受机制，同时实现弱稳定性、双方帕累托有效、工人弱群体策略防操纵以及强多项式时间可计算性。
en_tdlr: This paper constructs a deterministic generalized deferred acceptance mechanism for many-to-one matching markets with two-sided indifferences under gross substitutes preferences, achieving weak stability, two-sided Pareto efficiency, worker weak group strategy-proofness, and strong polynomial-time implementability.
